correctness.rationale: With B_theta(x)=1-(1+2theta*x)e^(-2theta*x), F=(B_theta(x)/B_theta(1))^alpha, alpha,theta>0, B_prime(1)=4theta²e^(-2theta)>0. Taylor gives 1-F=c(1-x)+O((1-x)²), f(1-)=c, c=alpha B_prime(1)/B_theta(1). Hence h~1/(1-x) and h_prime~1/(1-x)²; terminal hazard rises and global nonincrease impossible. Independently computed h(.1)=3.6531601598, h(.4)=2.9552667238, h(.99)=100.8683701 for alpha=.2,theta=1. No global turning-point classification.
